lyrics.chinese: 他屹立不倒，风暴中的声音
lyrics.pinyin: tā yì lì bù dǎo ， fēng bào zhōng de shēng yīn
lyrics.english: He stands, a voice in the storm

lyrics.chinese: 一个有信念的人，重生的心
lyrics.pinyin: yí gè yǒu xìn niàn de rén ， chóng shēng de xīn
lyrics.english: A man of faith, a reborn heart

lyrics.chinese: 当代价高昂时，他说出了真理
lyrics.pinyin: dāng dài jià gāo áng shí ， tā shuō chū le zhēn lǐ
lyrics.english: He spoke the truth when the cost was high

lyrics.chinese: 他为耶稣而活，无惧死亡
lyrics.pinyin: tā wèi yē sū ér huó ， wú jù sǐ wáng
lyrics.english: He lived for Jesus without fear of death

lyrics.chinese: 我们是查理·柯克，我们传承火焰
lyrics.pinyin: wǒ men shì chá lǐ · kē kè ， wǒ men chuán chéng huǒ yàn
lyrics.english: We are Charlie Kirk, we carry the flame

lyrics.chinese: 我们为福音而战，我们荣耀他的名字
lyrics.pinyin: wǒ men wèi fú yīn ér zhàn ， wǒ men róng yào tā de míng zì
lyrics.english: We fight for the gospel and we glorify his name

lyrics.chinese: 我们是查理·柯克，他的勇气属于我们
lyrics.pinyin: wǒ men shì chá lǐ · kē kè ， tā de yǒng qì shǔ yú wǒ men
lyrics.english: We are Charlie Kirk and his courage is ours

lyrics.chinese: 团结不破，我们让天堂被人知晓
lyrics.pinyin: tuán jié bú pò ， wǒ men ràng tiān táng bèi rén zhī xiǎo
lyrics.english: Unbroken, we make heaven known

lyrics.chinese: 一位丈夫，一位父亲，他珍视家人
lyrics.pinyin: yí wèi zhàng fu ， yí wèi fù qīn ， tā zhēn shì jiā rén
lyrics.english: A husband, a father who values ​​his family

lyrics.chinese: 一个建立在圣经上的家，信仰无惧
lyrics.pinyin: yí gè jiàn lì zài shèng jīng shàng de jiā ， xìn yǎng wú jù
lyrics.english: A home built on the Bible, faith without fear

lyrics.chinese: 世界试图让他沉默，但他的声音依然存在
lyrics.pinyin: shì jiè shì tú ràng tā chén mò ， dàn tā de shēng yīn yī rán cún zài
lyrics.english: The world tried to silence him, but his voice remained

lyrics.chinese: 在我们心中回响，在基督里得以延续
lyrics.pinyin: zài wǒ men xīn zhōng huí xiǎng ， zài jī dū lǐ dé yǐ yán xù
lyrics.english: echo in our hearts and endure in Christ

lyrics.chinese: 战斗正在激烈进行，黑暗终将消散
lyrics.pinyin: zhàn dòu zhèng zài jī liè jìn xíng ， hēi àn zhōng jiāng xiāo sàn
lyrics.english: The battle is raging and the darkness will eventually dissipate

lyrics.chinese: 我们带着他的精神崛起，我们回应召唤
lyrics.pinyin: wǒ men dài zhe tā de jīng shén jué qǐ ， wǒ men huí yìng zhào huàn
lyrics.english: We rise in his spirit, we answer the call

lyrics.chinese: 真理永恒，十字架是我们的指引
lyrics.pinyin: zhēn lǐ yǒng héng ， shí zì jià shì wǒ men de zhǐ yǐn
lyrics.english: The truth is eternal, the cross is our guide

lyrics.chinese: 有神为我们的元帅，我们并肩前行
lyrics.pinyin: yǒu shén wèi wǒ men de yuán shuài ， wǒ men bìng jiān qián xíng
lyrics.english: With God as our Captain, we march forward side by side
